title: Queensland Development Code, Parts MP1.1 and MP1.2
publisher: Queensland Department of Housing and Public Works
disclaimer: PLANNING SITING STANDARDS, NOT BUILDING CODE. MP1.1 and MP1.2 set siting for single detached Class 1a dwellings and associated Class 10 structures, split by lot size -- and codraft does not assert which part applies to which size, because the two are commonly cited the wrong way round. Check the part directly. A new Queensland Housing Code was proposed to commence 1 September 2026 and to REPLACE both parts, changing height, setbacks, privacy, parking, site cover and private open space; confirm what is in force on the application date. A local planning scheme may vary siting, and a siting dispensation can be sought from the council.

site.$comment: Indicative. Site cover under the QDC excludes eaves, sun shading and below-ground basements.

rules.title: Site cover
rules.message: Site cover is {coverage_ratio}; the QDC caps it at 50%.
rules.note: Site cover excludes eaves and sun shading devices, so the figure checked here is conservative.
